info.name: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling GET_ Delete Auto Scaling Group

params.name: AutoScalingGroupName
params.description: The name of the Auto Scaling group.

params.name: ForceDelete
params.description: Specifies that the group is to be deleted along with all instances associated with the group, without waiting for all instances to be terminated. This action also deletes any outstanding lifecycle actions associated with the group.

items.docs:
Deletes the specified Auto Scaling group.

If the group has instances or scaling activities in progress, you must specify the option to force the deletion in order for it to succeed. The force delete operation will also terminate the EC2 instances. If the group has a warm pool, the force delete option also deletes the warm pool.
